title: Samson's Last Victory and Death
description: Samson, blind and captured by the Philistines, asks God for strength one last time and brings down Dagon's temple, killing more enemies in his death than he did during his life.

versions.reason: [minor] references: The proposal partially overlaps with the existing 'Samson and Delilah' (16:4-31), but covers a distinct, bounded end narrative (imprisonment and death). A merge could be considered, but since the Samson cycle is large, this can stand as its own story.
